verdict.rationale: Core product function: docs and quickstart show giving a natural-language goal ('Find the top Hacker News story') and getting a completed run, with GitHub examples of multi-step flows like filling a job application form or scraping a followers list into CSV. Community hands-on report (comm-5) confirms it working for real login/session-based tasks like LinkedIn automation, and comm-1 confirms it functioning well in casual testing. Missing for 10: independent benchmark data on end-to-end success rate across varied complex flows, and no resolution of raised reliability/security concerns beyond anecdote.
